source_mapping.use: Plane-definition source ambiguity: main physical p5 Figure 5 describes the xy planes as mean planes defined by the benzothiophene-fused pentalene frameworks, whereas SI physical p14 describes mean planes defined by the pentalene frameworks. These wording differences do not establish that the resulting planes must differ. The inspected source passages do not fully specify the fitting atom set or coordinate transformation; no author atom indices are supplied here. For any plane-based NICS projection or ACID interpretation you use, report your plane definition and fitting convention, the explicit mapped atoms, and the transformation between molecular coordinates, response coordinates and the displayed view, including the magnetic-field direction and sign. The main caption places the ACID field along +z, perpendicular to the displayed xy plane and toward the reader. Distinguish the disclosed author conditions you reproduce, a scientifically justified substitution for missing details, and your own extensions. A documented, supported treatment of this ambiguity is acceptable; guessing an unpublished author atom set is not required. Assess the effect of a plane choice only as needed for the response or directional claim made, without a mandatory plane-comparison matrix.
